social_circle.name: Rosa Perezramos

demographics.occupation: Retired part-time office and childcare worker; homemaker

background.how_they_met: Miguel met Rosa when they were young in Puerto Rico, including memories of meeting her at a parish dance.
background.why_close: They have been married a little over fifty years, migrated from Puerto Rico together, raised three children, and still structure daily life around shared routines, faith, appointments, and household cooperation.

personality_mini_profile.communication_style: Texts in short, practical messages with reminders, check-ins, and occasional prayer or heart emojis. She is direct when worried and often uses Spanish phrases with Miguel.

recent_text_topics: Reminders about appointments, medicine refills, and what needs to go in the red bill folder.
Coordinating grocery lists for HEB or Fiesta, especially ingredients for arroz con gandules, pasteles, and sofrito.
Checking in when one of them is out running errands, especially about heat, traffic, or whether Miguel remembered his blood pressure medicine.
social_circle.evidence_from_interview: Q05: Miguel is married to Rosa Perezramos, calls her 'the center of my day,' and says they take morning walks together. Q11: Rosa keeps the house peaceful and keeps him from forgetting appointments. Q42: 'Rosa and I make those decisions together' about vaccines. Q44: Rosa helped after the misplaced medical bill incident.

social_circle.name: Elena Perezramos

background.how_they_met: Elena is Miguel and Rosa's adult daughter, raised in the family home after the move to Texas.
background.why_close: She lives nearby, visits most often, helps Miguel interpret medical paperwork and online information, and is one of the children he talks to almost every day.

personality_mini_profile.communication_style: Texts in clear full sentences, often with links, screenshots, and reminders. She is warm but efficient, and she will call if Miguel sounds anxious by text.

recent_text_topics: Helping Miguel understand a medical bill and whether a copay looked correct.
Sending reminders about CDC or doctor guidance, pharmacy questions, and upcoming appointments.
Photos and updates about her two children, including choir, soccer, school, and occasional pickup help.
social_circle.evidence_from_interview: Q05: Elena lives in Houston and works in a medical office; Miguel talks to at least one child almost every day. Q05 follow-up: Elena comes by most, once a week or every other week. Q36: Elena helps with insurance paperwork. Q23 and Q42: Elena helps with ballot details and CDC information.

demographics.occupation: HVAC technician and small business operator
demographics.education: High school diploma; HVAC trade training

background.how_they_met: Carlos is Miguel and Rosa's adult son, raised in the family after the move from Puerto Rico to Texas.
background.why_close: Carlos shares Miguel's practical repair background and is the child Miguel calls when a task is too heavy or unsafe. Their bond is built around tools, problem solving, and family responsibility.

personality_mini_profile.communication_style: Texts briefly and practically, often with photos of parts, times he can stop by, or quick jokes about tools. Less emotional than Elena, but reliable.

recent_text_topics: Whether Carlos can come by to lift or move something Miguel should not handle because of his knee and back.
Discussing the older Toyota's brake repair and whether the price sounded fair.
Checking on Carlos's business costs and work stress, with Miguel offering food, prayer, and advice only when asked.
social_circle.evidence_from_interview: Q05: Carlos lives in The Woodlands and does HVAC work. Q05 follow-up: Carlos comes when he can, especially if Miguel asks him to lift something he should not lift. Q33: Miguel hurt his knee after moving patio furniture when he should have asked Carlos. Q46: Carlos worries about his business costs.

background.why_close: Although she lives far away, she keeps a regular Sunday video-call rhythm with Miguel and Rosa, shares updates about the grandchildren, and misses being near the family.

personality_mini_profile.communication_style: Texts warmly with photos, voice notes, and family updates. She often sends short videos of the children or the family dog.

recent_text_topics: Planning the next visit from Orlando and where everyone would sleep in the Spring house.

Talking about how much she misses Miguel and Rosa and asking for Puerto Rican recipe reminders.
social_circle.evidence_from_interview: Q05: Marisol lives in Orlando with her husband. shared_activities: checking on church and neighborhood friends
recent_text_topics: Thursday coffee plans and whether Joe should bring pastries or Miguel should make coffee.
Cowboys news, Astros comments, and jokes about whose knees are worse that week.
Neighborhood safety and storm-prep messages, including strange cars, heavy rain, and checking whether both households have flashlights ready.
